name: Pocket Poly
author: Kyle McCann
tagline: a stereo polysynth with a discovery engine for the FM-1
description: Pocket Poly turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a stereo hybrid polysynth. Eight voices, each with two oscillators that can be analog shapes, phase-distorted sines, wavetables or a six-operator FM voice, with sync, ring and cross modulation; a resonant filter with drive, three envelopes, two LFOs, an eight-slot modulation matrix and four macros on the knobs; then an ensemble, a tape delay, a plate reverb and a limiter. An arpeggiator with twelve modes, Euclidean rhythms, chance, ratchets and a Turing machine follows MIDI clock, and DICE, MUTATE and MORPH find new patches.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
